# 3D Print Log

> 3D Print Log is a web app for tracking 3D prints, printers, filament, and print statistics, with direct-send integrations for OrcaSlicer, Bambu Studio, PrusaSlicer, Cura, Creality Print, and Anycubic slicers.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.3dprintlog.com/): Overview and free account signup.
- [Documentation](https://www.3dprintlog.com/docs/getting-started): Getting started, features, and integrations.

## Notes

- Public print and user pages are indexable; authenticated app data requires an account.
